headline: Freshman Dhima reaches ten goals for Western Oregon
dek: Archie Dhima, a freshman forward, has ten goals and two assists from 35 shots for Western Oregon, and nearly half of everything his side has scored this season. His side's draw with Simon Fraser and win over Western Washington leave them unbeaten in conference play.
